results.q: After launching a new ad set, how long am I supposed to wait before deciding if it's working?
results.answer: Wait at least 4 days before judging an ad set. This allows sufficient data collection to assess performance accurately. [S1] and [S3] both recommend this waiting period.

results.q: Are subtitles on vertical videos actually necessary or can I skip them?
results.answer: Subtitles are necessary for vertical videos because many viewers watch without sound. This is required to ensure accessibility and engagement, as per the editing workflow guidelines [S1].

results.q: What day and time do the live office hour sessions happen?
results.answer: Office hours happen every Tuesday at 7:00 PM IST. Because the sources disagree, a staff member will confirm the current guidance.

results.q: When I find a winning ad set, by how much should I raise its budget and how often?
results.answer: Raise the budget by 20 percent every three days. Large sudden jumps reset learning and increase costs. Instead, duplicate the winning ad set into a new audience rather than editing the original. [S1]

results.q: Is a long 40 page ebook a good first freebie to grow my email list?
results.answer: No, a long 40-page ebook is not a good first lead magnet. A good lead magnet solves one narrow problem quickly, such as a one-page checklist or a 10-minute video. Long ebooks are discouraged as a first lead magnet [S1].

results.q: What should each of the five welcome emails contain?
results.answer: Email 1 delivers the lead magnet; Email 2 tells your story; Email 3 shares a quick win; Email 4 handles a common objection; Email 5 makes a soft offer. [S1]

results.q: My emails get opened by about 28% of my small list — is that healthy?
results.answer: No, 28% is below the healthy open rate of 35–50% for a small, engaged list. This may indicate deliverability or relevance issues. [S1]

results.q: How do I tell if my niche statement is too vague?
results.answer: Use the 'one sentence' rule: if you cannot say who you help and what result they get in one sentence, the niche is too broad [S1].

results.q: What equipment do I really need to start filming short videos on a tight budget?
results.answer: A phone and a clip-on lavalier microphone are essential. Natural light through a window is sufficient. A ring light is optional for beginners. Audio quality is more important than video quality [S1].

results.q: How often should I remove people who never open my emails?
results.answer: Every 90 days, remove subscribers who have not opened any email in that period, after sending them a re-engagement email. [S1]

results.q: As testimonials come in, when should I bump up my starter offer price and by how much?
results.answer: Raise the price by 20 percent after every five testimonials [S1].

results.q: How many follow-ups should I send after a discovery call, and when?
results.answer: You should send three follow-ups: one the same day with a recap, one on day 3 with a relevant case study, and one on day 7 with a direct question. After the third follow-up, move the lead to your monthly newsletter. [S1]
